value.title: Open a build pod's step worktree
value.summary: Make the step's branch in its own worktree off the base, then record that folder as the pod's work-folder so `pij pod down` records where the step stands. The shipped build pod names it as its up procedure.

value.who: The build pod's project manager, or whoever ran `pij pod up`.
value.when: Right after `pij pod up shipped:build`, from the repo's main checkout, with `--key pod-<pod>` (the pod's name is read from the key).

value.name: branch
value.description: the step's new branch, e.g. feat/008-s02

value.name: folder
value.description: the worktree's absolute folder; it must not exist yet, or already be this branch's worktree

value.fix: run it with --key pod-<pod>, the pod `pij pod up` made

value.title: Make the branch in its own worktree
Record the folder as the pod's work-folder

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: The step has its own branch and worktree, and the pod knows the folder, so pod down records its head.

value.text: It does not install the worktree's dependencies; run the repo's own setup (in pij, `just worktree-deps`).
Running it from inside another worktree: the new worktree is still made, but off that checkout's repository; run it from the main checkout.

value.guarantees: The shipped build pod's open procedure.

value.why: Step 0001 adds the worktree and its branch.
